notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (6): Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough, Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, The Signal (starting Interrupt, used instead of Heading For The Medical Frigate) and Squadron Assignments; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Tatooine (Coruscant version)' dested the Light Coruscant-set Tatooine system.
Posted 'Lando With Blaster Rifle' dested Lando With Blaster Pistol (Cloud City): the only card named Lando With Blaster Rifle is a much later virtual card (Virtual Set 25).
Posted 'Ralltir Freighter Captain' dested Ralltiir Freighter Captain; 'Millenium Falcon' dested Millennium Falcon.
'Crazy Crap (3)' is the section header for X-wing Laser Cannon and 2x I'll Take The Leader, not a card; posted 'X-Wing Laser Cannons' dested X-wing Laser Cannon.
Battle Plan is the plain Effect as listed (the post says he does not own the Battle Plan & Draw Their Fire combo card).

Revised version of his 'Goggled Cheese' list posted the same day (DeckTech 18771): adds Phylo Gandish and a second Melas (Characters 18 → 20) and drops Noble Sacrifice (Interrupts 19 → 18) and The Planet That It's Farthest From (Effects 6 → 5). The post calls it his ideal version, including cards he did not own.

The strategy says this is a pre-Reflections III posting and suggests adding the Battle Plan combo and swapping one Ralltiir Freighter Captain for a second Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; those changes are not in the list, which is kept as posted.
